metadata.description: The @dereekb/llm/openrouter entry (rollup, inferred from rollup.config.cjs): compiles into dist/packages/llm/openrouter and is named by the parent's `./openrouter` export. An explicit edge to llm:build-base, NOT `^build`: `^build` would resolve to llm:build, which depends on this very target -- a hard cycle. The edge holds even before this entry imports @dereekb/llm, because llm:build-base deletes the dist directory this entry writes into. A sibling entry it imports adds `{ projects: [<sibling>], target: build-base }`; another family (e.g. util) adds that family's ROOT `build`. The parent's `build` aggregates this target, so the entry has no `build` of its own. This entry imports its sibling @dereekb/llm/openai, hence the llm-openai:build-base edge. No source file here imports @dereekb/util directly any more, but the @dereekb/llm declarations it compiles against do, so `implicitDependencies: ["util"]` keeps the util graph edge that lets withNx resolve @dereekb/util to its dist (without it the build pulls util's source and fails TS6059).
